package.name: genie_sim_engine_isaacsim
package.description:
Isaac Sim / Kit backend for the GenieSim engine platform.
Ships the Kit lifecycle helpers (bootstrap, stage), the PhysicsEngine implementations that run under Isaac Sim (isaac_newton, isaac_physx), the URDF→USD + Isaac scene-assembly stages, and the isaac_newton assemble pipeline factory. The genie_sim_engine_isaacsim_node.py entry point is installed here.
The paired Newton-standalone (Kit-free) package is genie_sim_engine_newton.
